title: Giraffe reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f2b23a'/>

  <circle cx='32' cy='68' r='3' fill='#c97d22'/>

  <rect x='46' y='84' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e0a02a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e0a02a'/>

  <path d='M55 66 Q64 50 62 34' stroke='#f2b23a' stroke-width='11' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#c97d22'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#c97d22'/>

  <circle cx='68' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#8a4b1c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='24' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#e0a02a'/>

  <ellipse cx='71' cy='31' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f7d28a'/>

  <circle cx='64' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a10'/>

  <path d='M30 74 L30 88 L48 88 L48 74 Z' fill='#3f7fd6'/>

  <line x1='33' y1='83' x2='37' y2='83.7' stroke='#8aaedc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='80.7' x2='45' y2='80' stroke='#8aaedc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='83.7' x2='45' y2='83' stroke='#8aaedc' stroke-width='1'/>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='75' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#8a4b1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='75' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#8a4b1c'/>
